plugin.name: The Godfather Widescreen Fix
PreferWidescreenResolutions.description: Prioritize widescreen display modes when more resolutions are available than the game can list. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Also applies to cutscene cameras.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Enhanced: everything turned up
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu (this fix and other plugins). Automatic follows the game.
